definitions.explanation: Bright, colorful, or attention-grabbing in appearance; standing out through boldness.
Grand or excessive in spending or lifestyle.

examples.japanese: {派手|はで}な{服|ふく}を{着|き}ている。
{派手|はで}に{転|ころ}んでしまった。
examples.notes: {派手|はで}に = in a flashy/spectacular way

examples.japanese: あのお{店|みせ}は{派手|はで}な{看板|かんばん}が{目立|めだ}つ。
examples.english: That shop stands out with its flashy sign.

examples.japanese: {結婚式|けっこんしき}では{派手|はで}な{衣装|いしょう}を{着|き}た{招待客|しょうたいきゃく}が{多|おお}く、{会場|かいじょう}がとても{華|はな}やかだった。
examples.english: At the wedding, many guests wore flashy outfits, making the venue very glamorous.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{派手|はで}な{生活|せいかつ}を{送|おく}っている。
{派手|はで}な{買|か}い{物|もの}をして{後悔|こうかい}した。
{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}は{派手|はで}に{遊|あそ}んでいた。
examples.english: In my younger days, I used to live it up.
examples.notes: {派手|はで}に{遊|あそ}ぶ = to party hard, to live extravagantly

examples.japanese: {宝|たから}くじに{当|あ}たって{派手|はで}にお{金|かね}を{使|つか}った{結果|けっか}、{数年|すうねん}で{全部|ぜんぶ}なくなってしまった。
examples.english: After winning the lottery and spending lavishly, all the money was gone within a few years.

notes:
USAGE: {派手|はで} describes things that stand out visually or attract attention. It can be neutral or slightly negative depending on context.

FORMS:
・{派手|はで}な + noun (flashy ~)
・{派手|はで}に + verb (flashily, spectacularly)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{派手|はで}な{色|いろ} (bright/flashy colors)
・{派手|はで}な{服|ふく} (flashy clothes)
・{派手|はで}に{使|つか}う (to spend lavishly)
・{派手|はで}に{転|ころ}ぶ (to fall spectacularly)

ANTONYM:
・{地味|じみ} (plain, subdued, quiet)

NUANCE: {派手|はで} can be positive (eye-catching, impressive) or negative (gaudy, tasteless) depending on context and speaker's tone.
